thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8901 — inference-cell-7 request-queue backlog > 4k, average queue latency 12s, capacity exhausted, autoscaler reported errors.

pagerduty: Notifying primary on-call: @alice_oncall — page sent.

alice_oncall: acked — I'm on it. patching in for initial triage.

ben_sre: I can see the backlog in /cells/inference-cell-7. Autoscaler logs show repeated 429 from metrics API. suspect metricsserver throttling.

carla_runtime: grabbing autoscaler pod logs now, here's a snippet:

```
2026-03-15T12:34:56Z autoscaler INFO reconcile start for inference-cell-7
2026-03-15T12:34:58Z autoscaler ERROR failed to fetch metrics: 429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-15T12:35:02Z autoscaler WARN reconcile aborted, retrying in 5s
```

carla_runtime: also seeing HPA controller events: `failed to get metrics for target` repeated.

alice_oncall: good find. manual mitigation plan: 1) scale the inference deployment replicas up to relieve queue, 2) restart autoscaler to clear rate-limit backoff, 3) open emergency route to Dedicated capacity if scale doesn't catch up.

dave_prod: Customer impact: a few customers reporting increased 5xx + timeouts on embeddings endpoints (SLI spike). Already flagged top-tier accounts in support dashboard.

elaine_support: I'm sending a brief to affected customers and opening tickets. will add incident note and the list of customer IDs.

ben_sre: executing manual replica scale now to buy time: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-cell-7 --replicas=20` 

alice_oncall: doing a quick restart of autoscaler pod to reset any backoff: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-controller`

incident-bot: Action logged: manual scale + autoscaler restart.

carla_runtime: after scale we see queue drain rate improved, latency down to ~6s but still above target. autoscaler restarting, awaiting healthy.

ben_sre: autoscaler came up, but immediately hit rate limit again when fetching custom metrics. metrics provider is getting hammered by scrape spikes.

alice_oncall: temporary change: increase HPA minReplicas to 8 to avoid further under-provisioning while we fix metrics. `kubectl -n inference patch hpa/inference-cell-7 --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":8}]'`

carla_runtime: patched, new minReplicas applied. pods being scheduled, some pending due to node pressure.

ben_sre: nodepool autoscaling currently at max for spot pool. I've requested a manual nodepool scale for hotpool (n1-inference-hot) via infra runbook: increasing desired to +4 nodes.

alice_oncall: infra approved manual node add, nodes provisioning. Meanwhile enabling fallback routing to dedicated-capacity for critical customers: `route-proxy set-route inference -> dedicated-capacity` for whitelist.

dave_prod: thumbs up. This will protect SLAs for enterprise customers while we stabilize.

elaine_support: updated customers: ACME, DataCorp, BetaApps — notified of degraded performance and that we're routing to dedicated capacity for them.

carla_runtime: monitoring metricsserver: adding short-term mitigation: increase metrics scraping window and reduce scrape frequency for bulky endpoints per runbook to reduce pressure.

ben_sre: confirmed queue length trending down now. backlog at ~1200 and dropping. 5xx count decreasing.

alice_oncall: good. root cause hypothesis: metrics provider throttled under sudden burst, autoscaler couldn't fetch metrics -> no scale decisions -> queue grew -> node pool hit max -> capacity exhausted. Follow-ups: implement backoff jitter, add local fallback to CPU-based scaling, and add guardrail to route heavy customers to dedicated earlier.

dave_prod: please capture impact metrics for postmortem (error rates, impacted customers, minutes to mitigation). I'm opening a postmortem doc and adding this thread link.

elaine_support: saving ticket numbers and customer comms in the doc.

alice_oncall: status: backlog draining, autoscaler healthy, nodepool increased manually. Remaining items: 1) revert temporary HPA minReplicas change after stabilization, 2) coordinate with infra to raise metrics provider quota, 3) schedule postmortem.

ben_sre: I'll own follow-up 2 and 3. will also add a short-term config to limit concurrent metric queries from autoscaler.

carla_runtime: I'll prepare a rollback plan for the route-proxy change and a small experiment to throttle autoscaler metric fetches.

alice_oncall: handing off to ben for extended follow-up. I'll remain reachable for 10m for questions and will post handoff notes. Handoff ETA +30m to next on-call. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben_sre: ack — I'll take the next 2 hours and run the postmortem prep. will update this thread with timeline and actions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-8901 acknowledged by alice_oncall, escalated to L2 (ben_sre).

pagerduty: PD-8901 status: acknowledged -> resolved (manual mitigations active, monitoring).

alice_oncall: marking my on-call handoff note: manual nodepool scale + HPA minReplicas=8 applied, autoscaler restarted, dedicated routing enabled for whitelist, customers notified. Leaving thread to ben.

ben_sre: closing operational loop for now. will convert to follow-up ticket RFC-2048 for long-term fixes.

elaine_support: adding final customer updates and closing priority tickets for the incident.

carla_runtime: monitoring shows stable for 20m, queue at steady-state ~120.

alice_oncall: thanks team. :heart:
